g.text: Native Xray subscription manager, intelligent routing, DNS & LAN proxy for OpenWrt / ImmortalWrt
Single shared source of truth across all clients

parser module: auto-detection of formats & protocols

Probe Engine • Health Evaluation & Auto Selection
probe, speedtest, and smart anti-flap switching

• Score: latency, successful checks, and failures
• Egress checks via generate_204 during connection
• Periodic checks and cooldown limit repeated switching

Connections may be interrupted during node changes

Zero client configuration needed on phones, PCs, or TVs

3. dnsmasq adds IPs from DNS replies to an nftables set

4. UDP: ip daddr @proxy_target_v4 meta mark set 0x1 tproxy to :12345
